section.content: 本发明提供种半导体集成电路。半导体集成电路包括端子、成二极管连接的MOS晶体管、保护二极管电路、电池放电用MOS晶体管、电池电压检测控制电路、以及过电压保护用箝位电路。电池防电涌MOS晶体管分别连接在端子中的相邻的各端子之间。成二极管连接的MOS晶体管分别连接在端子中相邻的各端子之间。从而，在相邻的端子之间施加了浪涌电压的情况下，能保护连接在相邻的端子之间的电路元件使其不受到因浪涌电压导致的静电破坏。

This invention provides a semiconductor integrated circuit having a plurality of terminals, a MOS transistor in diode connection, a protection diode circuit, a MOS transistor for battery discharging, a battery voltage detection control circuit, and an overvoltage protection clamp circuit. Battery surge protection MOS transistors are connected between neighboring terminals. The MOS transistor in diode connection are connected between neighboring terminals. Thus, when surge voltage is applied between neighboring terminals, circuit elements between neighboring terminals can be protected against static damage caused by the surge voltage.

Semiconductor integrated circuitTechnical field

The application be submit on March 21st, 2011, application number be 201110070228.4, denomination of invention be the divisional application of application of " semiconductor integrated circuit ".

Background technology

In recent years, the various equipment using the TunePowers such as lithium ion battery or charger are developed.Correspondingly, develop the voltage of multiple batteries that detection is connected in series, and control the semiconductor integrated circuit of the voltage of battery based on this voltage.

In this semiconductor integrated circuit, for protecting internal circuit to make it be not subjected to be applied between protection circuit and power line and the ground connection of the impact of the surge voltage overvoltage of input terminal, it is provided with clamp circuit.

In patent documentation 1, disclose and share 1 protection circuit thus reducing the semiconductor integrated circuit of circuit scale by multiple input terminals.In patent documentation 2, disclose the semiconductor integrated circuit of the circuit area cutting down the clamp circuit being arranged between power line and ground connection.

Patent documentation 1: Japanese Unexamined Patent Publication 2001-267496 publication

Patent documentation 2: Japanese Unexamined Patent Publication 2009-104455 publication

But, in the semiconductor integrated circuit that above-mentioned battery controls, between adjacent terminal, connect component sometimes.Such as, in order to make battery discharge, connecting valve element between 2 adjacent input terminals.Further, when switching elements ON, plus end and the negative terminal of battery are shorted, thus battery is discharged, the voltage of battery reduces.In such semiconductor integrated circuit, there is the problem that when being applied in surge voltage between input terminal, switch element can be destroyed.

Summary of the invention

The semiconductor integrated circuit of the present invention carries out in view of above-mentioned problem, this semiconductor integrated circuit has multiple terminal, connects battery between adjacent terminal respectively, and this semiconductor integrated circuit is characterised by, possessing: component, it is connected between adjacent terminal；And overvoltage protection element, it is connected between adjacent terminal, protects the impact of overvoltage that described component makes it be not subjected between adjacent terminal to apply.

Additionally, the semiconductor integrated circuit of the present invention, there is at least the 1st to the 3rd terminal, the 1st battery is connected between the 1st terminal and the 2nd terminal, the 2nd battery is connected between the 2nd terminal and the 3rd terminal, this semiconductor integrated circuit is characterised by possessing: the 1st component, and it is connected between the 1st terminal and the 2nd terminal；1st overvoltage protection element, it is connected between the 1st terminal and the 2nd terminal, protects described 1st component to make its impact being not subjected to overvoltage；2nd component, it is connected between the 2nd terminal and the 3rd terminal；2nd overvoltage protection element, it is connected between the 2nd terminal and the 3rd terminal, protects described 2nd component to make its impact being not subjected to overvoltage；Protection diode circuit, it is connected with the 2nd terminal；With the 3rd overvoltage protection element, it is connected between the 1st terminal and the 3rd terminal.

(invention effect)

Semiconductor integrated circuit according to the present invention, when being applied with surge voltage between adjacent terminal, it is possible to protection is connected to the component between adjacent terminal so that it is be not subjected to the electrostatic breakdown because surge voltage causes.

Detailed description of the invention

[the 1st embodiment]

Based on Fig. 1 and Fig. 2, the semiconductor integrated circuit 100 of the 1st embodiment of the present invention is illustrated.As it can be seen, semiconductor integrated circuit 100 includes: the clamp circuit 20 of MOS transistor MNO～MN15 (example of " overvoltage protection element " of the present invention), protection diode circuit HDO～HD14, battery discharge MOS transistor T1～T14 (example of " component ", " switch element " of the present invention), battery voltage detection control circuit 10 and overvoltage protection that terminals P 0～P14, one-tenth diode connect.Additionally, in FIG, for convenience's sake, terminals P 2～P10 and the diagram of corresponding circuit thereof are eliminated.

In semiconductor integrated circuit 100, the circuit (MOS transistor MN14, battery discharge MOS transistor T14 etc.) formed corresponding to adjacent 2 terminals (such as terminals P 14 and terminals P 13) defines a unit, and repeats to configure this unit.

Between adjacent each terminal of terminals P 0～P14, respectively connected the battery BV1～BV14 such as lithium ion battery.That is, terminals P 14 is connected to the plus end of battery BV14, and terminals P 13 is connected to the negative terminal of battery BV14.It addition, terminals P 13 is connected to the plus end of battery BV13, terminals P 12 is connected to the negative terminal of battery BV13.So, battery BV1～BV14 connects at the external series of semiconductor integrated circuit 100, generates high voltage.

Battery discharge MOS transistor T1～T14, is connected to via wiring between adjacent each terminal of terminals P 0～P14.Such as, battery discharge MOS transistor T14 is connected between terminals P 14 and terminals P 13, and battery discharge MOS transistor T13 is connected between terminals P 13 and terminals P 12.

Battery voltage detection control circuit 10, by the voltage between the adjacent each terminal in detection terminal P0～P14, detects the voltage of battery BV1～BV14, and controls the ON-OFF of battery discharge MOS transistor T1～T14 according to this testing result.

That is, battery voltage detection control circuit 10, during other battery height of the voltage ratio of a certain battery in detecting battery BV1～BV14, turns on the battery discharge MOS transistor being connected between corresponding terminal.Thus, plus end and the negative terminal of this battery are shorted, thus this battery is discharged, the voltage of battery reduces.

Such as, battery voltage detection control circuit 10, when detecting the voltage height of voltage versus cell BV13 of battery BV14, makes the battery discharge MOS transistor T14 conducting being connected between terminals P 14 and terminals P 13.Thereby, it is possible to make each electric voltage equalization of battery BV1～BV14.

Become diode connect MOS transistor MN0～MN15 be made up of low pressure pressure for the such as 5V N-channel type MOS transistor being connected to grid G, source S and back grid, and as with source S be anode, drain D be negative electrode diode play a role.MOS transistor MN1～MN14 is connected between the adjacent each terminal in terminals P 0～P14 via wiring.

Such as, MOS transistor MN14 is connected between terminals P 14 and terminals P 13 via wiring, and MOS transistor MN13 is connected between terminals P 13 and terminals P 12 via wiring.MOS transistor MN0～MN15 is generally in cut-off, but turns on when being applied in surge voltage between corresponding terminal, to protect battery discharge MOS transistor T1～T14.In this case, it is possible to replacement MOS transistor MN0～MN15, and diode or P-channel type MOS transistor are used, but as the preferred MOS transistor MN0～MN15 of overvoltage protection element.Its reason is in that, the current driving ability of N-channel type MOS transistor MNO～MN15 is strong, is suitable for quickly removing surge voltage.

MOS transistor MN15 is connected between terminals P 14 and power line 30.In common use, terminals P 14 and power line 30 are attached via the outside wiring of semiconductor integrated circuit 100.In this case, MOS transistor MN15 for protecting semiconductor integrated circuit 100 when semiconductor integrated circuit 100 is assembled into packaging part so that it is is not subjected to the electrostatic breakdown that surge causes.After terminals P 14 and power line 30 are shorted by connection, MOS transistor MN15 plays a role not as electrostatic breakdown protection element.

Protection diode circuit HD0～HD14 is connected with terminals P 0～P14 respectively via wiring.Protection diode circuit HD0～HD14 possesses: be connected to the 1st diode D1 between terminals P X (X=0～14) and power line 30 and the 2nd diode D2 being connected between terminals P X and ground connection.In this case, owing to applying this voltage of VDDH on the 1st diode D1 being connected in series and the 2nd diode D2, therefore needing is the pressure diode of the height of this voltage resistance to.

Clamp circuit 20 is the circuit that the current potential VDDH of power line 30 has carried out clamp when being applied in surge voltage, for instance, as in figure 2 it is shown, be connected in series by 8 low pressure MOS transistor MP1～MP8 that grid, source electrode and back grid are shorted and constitute.In this case, MOS transistor MP1～MP8 is in order to prevent locking (latch-up) phenomenon, it is preferable that formed with P-channel type.

Hereinafter, illustrate to semiconductor integrated circuit 100 be applied with surge voltage when protection act.

(1) between adjacent terminal, it is applied with the situation of surge voltage:

Such as, between terminals P 14 and terminals P 13, surge voltage (such as hundreds of V) is applied.Polarity according to surge voltage, when terminals P 13 be high potential, terminals P 14 for electronegative potential, become the MOS transistor MN14 clockwise direction that diode connects to connect.On the contrary, when terminals P 13 be electronegative potential, terminals P 14 for high potential because being applied with reverse biased to MOS transistor MN14, therefore MOS transistor MN14 turns on because of avalanche breakdown.

Thus, flow surge current in MOS transistor MN14, and the surge voltage between terminals P 14 and terminals P 13 decays rapidly, therefore prevents the electrostatic breakdown of the battery discharge MOS transistor T14 being connected between terminals P 14 and terminals P 13.The situation of surge voltage it is applied with too between the terminal that other are adjacent.

(2) situation of surge voltage it is applied with to terminal:

(a) with earthing potential VSS for benchmark to each terminals P X be just applied with (+) the situation of surge voltage: such as; to terminals P 14 be applied with positive surge voltage that earthing potential VSS is benchmark when; define the 1st diode D1 (clockwise direction biasing) via protection diode circuit HD14 from terminals P 14, then pass through clamp circuit 20 until the surge current path of ground connection.The surge current along with surge voltage is eliminated by this surge current path.Thus, battery discharge MOS transistor T1～T14, the such internal circuit of battery voltage detection control circuit 10 obtain protection, it does not have be subject to the electrostatic breakdown because surge voltage causes.About other terminals P 0～P13 too.

(b) with earthing potential VSS for benchmark to each terminals P X be applied with negative (-) the situation of surge voltage: such as; to terminals P 14 be applied with negative surge voltage that earthing potential VSS is benchmark when, define from ground connection by protecting the 2nd diode D2 (clockwise direction biasing) of diode circuit HD14 until the surge current path of terminals P 14.The surge current along with surge voltage is eliminated by this surge current path.Thus, battery discharge MOS transistor T1～T14, the such internal circuit of battery voltage detection control circuit 10 obtain protection, it does not have be subject to the electrostatic breakdown because surge voltage causes.About other terminals P 0～P13 too.

(c) with the current potential VDDH of power line 30 for benchmark to each terminals P X be just applied with (+) the situation of surge voltage: such as; to terminals P 14 be applied with current potential VDDH be benchmark just (+) surge voltage when, define from terminals P 14 by protecting the 1st diode D1 (clockwise direction biasing) of diode circuit HD14 until the surge current path of power line 30.The surge current along with surge voltage is eliminated by this surge current path.Thus, battery discharge MOS transistor T1～T14, the such internal circuit of battery voltage detection control circuit 10 obtain protection, it does not have be subject to the destruction because surge voltage causes.About other terminals P 0～P13 too.

(d) with the current potential VDDH of power line 30 for benchmark to each terminals P X be applied with negative (-) the situation of surge voltage: such as; to terminals P 14 be applied with current potential VDDH be benchmark negative (-) surge voltage when, define from power line 30 via clamp circuit 20, the 2nd diode D2 (clockwise direction biasing) then passing through protection diode circuit HD14 until the surge current path of terminals P 14.The surge current along with surge voltage is eliminated by this surge current path.

Thus, battery discharge MOS transistor T1～T14, the such internal circuit of battery voltage detection control circuit 10 obtain protection, it does not have be subject to the destruction because surge voltage causes.About other terminals P 0～P13 too.

Above, according to semiconductor integrated circuit 100, when being applied in surge voltage between adjacent terminal, and when each terminal is applied in surge voltage, it is possible to prevent the electrostatic breakdown of the internal circuits such as battery discharge MOS transistor T1～T14.

Additionally, in the present embodiment, semiconductor integrated circuit 100 is made up of 14 unit in the way of can connecting 14 battery BV1～BV14, but its unit number also suitably can increase and decrease in more than one scope.It addition, the battery discharge MOS transistor T1～T14 being connected between adjacent terminal is an example, it is also possible to replace it to connect other components.Even if in this case, by becoming MOS transistor MN0～MN15 that diode connects also to be able to protect described component.

[the second embodiment]

Based on Fig. 3, the semiconductor integrated circuit 200 of the 2nd embodiment of the present invention is illustrated.Additionally, in figure 3, for convenience's sake, terminals P 3～P9 and the diagram of corresponding circuit thereof are eliminated.

In the semiconductor integrated circuit 100 of the 1st embodiment, each terminals P 0～P14 is provided with HD0～HD14, is also provided with clamp circuit 20 further, therefore the circuit scale of protection circuit is big.

Therefore; in the semiconductor integrated circuit 200 of present embodiment; in order to cut down circuit scale; only remain HD1, HD3, HD5, HD7, HD9, HD11, HD13 corresponding with odd number terminal (terminals P 1 etc.) in protection diode circuit HD0～HD14, and delete HD0, HD2, HD4, HD6, HD8, HD10, HD12, the HD14 corresponding with terminal (terminals P 0 etc.) in addition.That is, protection diode circuit arranges one every a terminal, and its number is substantially halved.

It addition, delete clamp circuit 20, replace by arranging 7 MOS transistor MP11～MP17 becoming diode to connect, ensure that surge current path.Thus, not only can ensure that overvoltage protecting but also can achieve the reduction of circuit scale.Other circuit constitute identical with the 1st embodiment.

That is, semiconductor integrated circuit 200 includes terminals P 0～P14, becomes the MOS transistor MN0～MN15 (example of " overvoltage protection element " of the present invention) of diode connection, protection diode circuit HD1, HD3, HD5, HD7, HD9, HD11, HD13, battery discharge MOS transistor T1～T14 (example of " component ", " switch element " of the present invention), battery voltage detection control circuit 10, becomes the MOS transistor MP11～MP17 of diode connection to constitute.

MOS transistor MP11～MP17 that diode connects is become to arrange 1 in every 2 unit.In this case, MOS transistor MP11～MP17 is made up of the P-channel type MOS transistor being connected to grid G, source S and back grid, and as with source S be negative electrode, with drain D be anode diode play a role.

Such as, MOS transistor MP11 is connected between ground connection and terminals P 2 via wiring.MOS transistor MP16 is connected between terminals P 10 and terminals P 12 via wiring.MOS transistor MP17 is connected between terminals P 12 and terminals P 14 via wiring.As on the whole, MOS transistor MP11～MP17 is connected in series between terminals P 14 and ground connection.

When battery BV1～BV14 is connected to semiconductor integrated circuit 200, the voltage of 2 batteries of series connection is applied respectively to into, as reverse biased, MOS transistor MP11～MP17 that diode connects, therefore MOS transistor MP11～MP17 needs have the pressure of this voltage resistance to.Further, when applying surge voltage to each terminal, by the polarity of this surge voltage, when clockwise direction biases, clockwise direction is connected, and causes avalanche breakdown when reverse biased.

MOS transistor MP11～MP17 also can be formed with N-channel type, but formed with P-channel type and can prevent latch-up phenomenon.
